_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Kenya covering Turkana Boy and early hominids, Swahili coast and Mombasa, British East Africa, Mau Mau uprising, Kenyatta/Moi/Kibaki eras, 2007 election violence, 2010 constitution, and Kenya as East African hub.

ethnic_groups.name: Kikuyu
ethnic_groups.notes: Largest group; Central/Rift Valley; Bantu-speaking; historically dominant in politics; GEMA alliance; Mau Mau origins

ethnic_groups.name: Luhya
ethnic_groups.notes: Western Kenya; Bantu; diverse 18+ sub-groups including Bukusu, Maragoli, Luo neighbors

ethnic_groups.name: Kalenjin
ethnic_groups.notes: Rift Valley; Nilotic cluster including Nandi, Kipsigis, Marakwet; long-distance runners; Moi's base

ethnic_groups.name: Luo
ethnic_groups.notes: Nyanza/Lake Victoria; Nilotic; fishing and agriculture; politically significant; Obama family heritage; Odinga political dynasty

ethnic_groups.name: Kamba
ethnic_groups.notes: Eastern Kenya; Bantu; Ukambani; historically traders and colonial Kamba Carriers Corps

ethnic_groups.name: Kisii (Gusii)
ethnic_groups.notes: Nyanza; Bantu; highlands tea and pyrethrum; densely populated

ethnic_groups.name: Meru/Embu/Mbeere
ethnic_groups.notes: Eastern slopes of Mt. Kenya; Bantu; GEMA alliance with Kikuyu

ethnic_groups.name: Mijikenda
ethnic_groups.notes: Coastal; nine related groups including Giriama, Digo, Duruma; kaya sacred forests

ethnic_groups.name: Maasai
ethnic_groups.notes: Southern Rift Valley; Nilotic pastoralists; iconic culture; cross-border with Tanzania; Mara ecosystem

ethnic_groups.name: Somali
ethnic_groups.notes: North Eastern Province; nomadic pastoralists; Darod, Hawiye, Ogadeni clans; Shifta War legacy; security challenges

ethnic_groups.name: Turkana
ethnic_groups.notes: Northwestern Kenya; Nilotic pastoralists; Lake Turkana; Turkana Boy fossil site

ethnic_groups.name: Samburu
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern Rift Valley; Nilotic; closely related to Maasai

ethnic_groups.name: Pokot/Rendille/Borana/Orma
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern Kenya; pastoralists; cross-border ties with Ethiopia and Somalia

ethnic_groups.name: Swahili/Arab/Shirazi
ethnic_groups.notes: Coastal; Mombasa, Lamu, Malindi; Islamic heritage; trade and seafaring

ethnic_groups.name: Asian (South Asian)
ethnic_groups.notes: Gujarati, Punjabi communities; commercial and professional class; arrived during colonial era

current_leader.name: William Ruto
current_leader.title: President
current_leader.notes: Deputy President 2013–2022 under Uhuru Kenyatta; broke alliance to win 2022 election; UDA party; 'hustler' narrative

former_presidents.name: Jomo Kenyatta
former_presidents.notes: Founding father; Mau Mau detainee; first PM 1963–1964, President 1964–1978; KANU; died in office

former_presidents.name: Daniel arap Moi
former_presidents.notes: 24-year rule; KANU; Nyayo philosophy; single-party era then 1992 multiparty transition; succession to Kibaki 2002

former_presidents.name: Mwai Kibaki
former_presidents.notes: NARC/PNU; economic growth; 2007 election crisis and power-sharing with Raila Odinga; 2010 constitution

former_presidents.name: Uhuru Kenyatta
former_presidents.notes: Son of Jomo Kenyatta; ICC case (dropped); Jubilee Alliance; Handshake with Raila 2018; contested succession by Ruto

910.name: Early Hominids and Prehistory
910.description: Kenya's Rift Valley as critical site for human evolution; Turkana Boy; Olorgesailie; Koobi Fora fossil beds.

sub_clusters.name: Turkana Boy and Homo erectus
sub_clusters.description: Discovery of Turkana Boy (Nariokotome Boy) near Lake Turkana — most complete Homo erectus skeleton; key to understanding human evolution.

sub_clusters.name: Koobi Fora and the Leakeys
sub_clusters.description: Richard and Meave Leakey's discoveries at Koobi Fora and Lake Turkana; multiple hominid species; stone tool assemblages.

sub_clusters.name: Later Stone Age and Pastoralism
sub_clusters.description: Hunter-gatherer communities; emergence of pastoralism; Nilotic, Cushitic, and Bantu migration waves reshape the region.

920.name: Swahili Coast Civilisation
920.description: Rise of Swahili city-states along the Kenyan coast; Mombasa, Lamu, and Malindi as major trading centres; Indian Ocean commerce.

sub_clusters.name: Early Swahili Settlements
sub_clusters.description: Proto-Swahili communities along the coast; iron-working; trade with Arabia and India; Bantu-speaking fishing communities.

sub_clusters.name: Rise of Mombasa, Lamu, and Malindi
sub_clusters.description: Mombasa emerges as major Swahili city-state; Lamu archipelago; coral stone architecture; ivory, gold, and slave trade; Islam as dominant religion.

930.name: Portuguese and Omani Periods
930.description: Vasco da Gama's arrival; Portuguese Fort Jesus; Omani Arab displacement of Portuguese; Mazrui dynasty in Mombasa.

sub_clusters.name: Portuguese East Africa
sub_clusters.description: Vasco da Gama visits Malindi 1498; Portuguese build Fort Jesus in Mombasa 1593; violent contestation with local sultanates.

sub_clusters.name: Omani Arab Control
sub_clusters.description: Omani siege takes Fort Jesus 1698 after 33-month siege; Mazrui governors establish semi-autonomy in Mombasa; slave trade intensifies.

940.name: British East Africa
940.description: Imperial British East Africa Company; Uganda Railway; White Highlands settler economy; African resistance and land dispossession.

sub_clusters.name: IBEAC and the Uganda Railway
sub_clusters.description: Imperial British East Africa Company; Berlin Conference allocation; Uganda Railway (Lunatic Express) 1896-1901; Nairobi founded as railway depot.

sub_clusters.name: White Highlands and Settler Economy
sub_clusters.description: European settlers given prime land in White Highlands; Crown Lands Ordinance; coffee and tea plantations; African labour exploitation; kipande pass system.

sub_clusters.name: Early African Resistance
sub_clusters.description: Harry Thuku; Young Kikuyu Association; Kenya African Union; Jomo Kenyatta's activism; land grievances intensify.

940.name: Mau Mau Uprising
940.description: Armed revolt against British colonial rule; state of emergency; detention camps; land and freedom movement.

sub_clusters.name: Mau Mau Armed Revolt
sub_clusters.description: Kikuyu-led revolt for land and freedom; state of emergency declared 1952; Kenyatta detained; forest fighters in Mount Kenya and Aberdares.

sub_clusters.name: Detention Camps and British Brutality
sub_clusters.description: British Pipeline detention system; torture and forced labour; Hola massacre 1959; estimated 11,000+ killed; legacy of land redistribution demands.

950.name: Independence, Kenyatta, and Moi Era
950.description: Independence under Jomo Kenyatta; harambee nation-building; Daniel arap Moi's authoritarian rule; multi-party transition.

sub_clusters.name: Independence and Kenyatta Presidency
sub_clusters.description: Independence 12 December 1963; Jomo Kenyatta as founding father; harambee philosophy; one-party tendencies; assassination of Tom Mboya and J.M. Kariuki.

sub_clusters.name: Daniel arap Moi Era
sub_clusters.description: Moi succeeds Kenyatta 1978; KANU single-party state; 1982 coup attempt; Nyayo torture chambers; multiparty elections 1992; ethnic clashes.

sub_clusters.name: Multiparty Transition
sub_clusters.description: Section 2A repeal allows multiparty politics 1991; divided opposition allows Moi to win 1992 and 1997; Moi retires 2002.

960.name: Modern Kenya: Democracy and Regional Hub
960.description: Kibaki era; 2007-08 post-election violence; 2010 constitution; Uhuru Kenyatta; William Ruto; Kenya as East African economic hub.

sub_clusters.name: Kibaki Presidency and Economic Growth
sub_clusters.description: Mwai Kibaki wins 2002; economic reforms; free primary education; infrastructure investment; 2005 constitutional referendum defeat.

sub_clusters.name: 2007-08 Post-Election Violence
sub_clusters.description: Disputed December 2007 election; ~1,500 killed and 600,000 displaced; ethnic violence; Kofi Annan mediation; ICC indictments.

sub_clusters.name: 2010 Constitution and Devolution
sub_clusters.description: New constitution promulgated 27 August 2010; devolution to 47 counties; bill of rights; reformed judiciary; two-thirds gender rule.

sub_clusters.name: Uhuru Kenyatta and William Ruto Era
sub_clusters.description: Uhuru-Ruto alliance wins 2013 despite ICC charges; BBI constitutional amendment attempt; Ruto wins 2022 on 'hustler' platform; tax protests 2024.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
